title: Answer Me When I Call

questions.question: Answer me when I call, O God of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:1 (ESV): "Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness!"

questions.question: Be angry, and do not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:4 (ESV): "Be angry, and do not sin;"

questions.question: Offer right sacrifices, and put your trust in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:5 (ESV): "Offer right sacrifices, and put your trust in the Lord."

questions.question: You have put more joy in my heart than they have when their what abound?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:7 (ESV): "You have put more joy in my heart than they have when their grain and wine abound."

questions.question: In peace I will both lie down and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:8 (ESV): "In peace I will both lie down and sleep;"

questions.question: You have given me relief when I was in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:1 (ESV): "You have given me relief when I was in distress."

questions.question: How long will you love vain words and seek after what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:2 (ESV): "How long will you love vain words and seek after lies?"

questions.question: But know that the Lord has set apart the godly for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:3 (ESV): "But know that the Lord has set apart the godly for himself;"

questions.question: Ponder in your own hearts on your beds, and be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:4 (ESV): "...ponder in your own hearts on your beds, and be silent."

questions.question: Lift up the light of your face upon us, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:6 (ESV): "...Lift up the light of your face upon us, O Lord!"

questions.question: For you alone, O Lord, make me dwell in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:8 (ESV): "...for you alone, O Lord, make me dwell in safety."

questions.question: O men, how long shall my honor be turned into what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:2 (ESV): "O men, how long shall my honor be turned into shame?"

questions.question: The Psalm is addressed to the Choirmaster: with what instruments?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4 Title: "To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments. A Psalm of David."

questions.question: Who asks, "Who will show us some good?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:6 (ESV): "There are many who say, 'Who will show us some good?'"

questions.question: The Lord hears when I call to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 4:3 (ESV): "...the Lord hears when I call to him."

key_verse_text: In peace I will both lie down and sleep; for you alone, O Lord, make me dwell in safety.
